label: A pure perfection actual through esse is a perfection of esse itself
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every x and pure perfection d, if d is actual in x through esse (the frame field, intended as ACTUALIZED_THROUGH_2; sense-neutral as above) then d is a perfection of esse itself (PERFECTION_OF_BEING_2, intensive esse). With R-dep, the first 'unde' and the witness premise it is equivalent to R-act2 (254ee26f). The text closest to it is the q.4 a.2 sentence 'omnium autem perfectiones pertinent ad perfectionem essendi' (5c5281dd) read constitutively, the sentence whose ground is under test.
